uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: When at least 5% max HP damage is received in a single attack, restores this Pokémon's HP and increases their movement speed by 15% for 1.5s; deals revenge damage to nearby opposing Pokémon and decreases their movement speed by 30% for 1.5s (10s CD). Damages an enemy and decreases its movement speed for a short time after receiving a certain amount of damage. When that happens, also recover HP and gain increased movement speed for a short time.

Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, attaching a bit of cotton fluff to opposing Pokémon for 3s and then damaging them. The user and their teammates' auto attacks against targets with cotton fluff on them deal additional damage and decrease their movement speed by 20% for 1s. Each teammate uses their own Sp. Atk to deal additional damage on targets with cotton fluff. This additional damage has an internal cooldown of 0.35s for each teammate. Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, attaching a bit of cotton fluff to the enemy. The user's basic attacks against an enemy with cotton fluff on it deal increased damage and decreases the enemies movement speed for a short time.

Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, attaching a bit of cotton fluff to the enemy. The user's basic attacks against an enemy with cotton fluff on it deal increased damage and decreases the enemies movement speed for a short time.

The user shoots a bundle of leaves in the designated direction which explodes on the first opposing Pokémon hit or after traveling max distance, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed by 40% for 2s. Pelt the target with leaves, decreasing the movement speed of enemies for a short time when it hits.

The user throws a Pollen Puff at the designated location which attaches to the nearest Pokémon within 0.5s. The Pollen Puff explodes 2s after attaching to a Pokémon, restoring the HP of the user's teammates and damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect. The Pollen Puff explodes on its own after 1s with the same effects if it doesn't attach to any Pokémon within the first 0.5s of landing. Throws a Pollen Puff, which attaches to an enemy. The Pollen Puff restores HP for allies and deals damage to enemies.

If the Pollen Puff attaches to a teammate, it reduces the damage that teammate receives by 20% for 2s before it explodes. If the Pollen Puff attaches to any Pokémon, opposing Pokémon that come in contact with the target receive damage over time every 0.5s before the Pollen Puff explodes. If a Pollen Puff attaches to enemies, it also deals them damage over time. If a Pollen Puff attaches to an ally, it also reduces the damage they receive.

The user launches a tornado of sharp leaves in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon hit by the tornado and creating a path in its wake that lasts for 4s. Teammates on the path have their movement speed increased by 60%, lingering for 2s after leaving the path. When the tornado reaches max distance, the tornado damages opposing Pokémon a second time. 25% of the damage of the first hit. Attack with a tornado of sharp leaves, leaving a path in its wake that increases ally movement speed for a short time.

Applies a debuff to opposing Pokémon hit by the tornado that causes auto attacks to deal no damage for 2.5s. Effects that only depend on auto attacks hitting and not on auto attacks dealing damage still occur. Also decreases the accuracy of enemies for a short time when this move hits.
The user uses sunlight to heal themself and teammates in the area of effect. Restores the HP of the user and nearby allies.

The user grants teammates in the area of effect cotton shields for 3s. After 3s, any cotton leftover is used to restore the HP of teammates with cotton shields for 15% of the remaining shield value. Protects the user and nearby allies with cotton. The cotton absorbs damage and when the move ends, the cotton restores some HP.
Increases the movement speed of teammates in the area of effect by 30% for 2s. Also increases the user's movement speed while using this move.

The user gathers spores around them for 2s, increasing their movement speed by 40% for 2s. The spores burst at the end, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect, throwing them for 0.5s and decreasing their movement speed by 40% for 2s when it hits. Cotton Cloud Crash can be used during this move, ending the move early and making the spores burst immediately. Gathers spores around the user, increasing the user's movement speed while this move is in effect. The spores burst after a short time, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect, throwing them, and decreasing their movement speed for a short time.
Increases the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 50% for 2s. Reduced damage taken while using this move.

The user becomes invincible as they float into the air for up to 3s, moving freely over obstacles and increasing their movement speed by 10% while in the air. If used again or after 3s, the user pounds the ground, restoring the HP of the user and teammates in the area of effect, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and shoving opposing Pokémon hit for 0.7s. Float into the air and become invincible. If used again, pound the ground, attacking and shoving enemies and restoring HP to allies in the area of effect.
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6
